properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): the field log's "revision changed:false after refusals" had two causes. (1) On 0.76.0 the third, refused add_decision call stored the node: reproduced exactly, and fixed in 0.78.0 (#655). (2) The reply said "nothing moved" although the call drew an edge: the 2026-09-28 cause. On main an edge-only revise still replies changed:false, "nothing moved", beside edges_drawn
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-05, triaging art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05 (tool surface). Binaries: 0.76.0 and 0.78.0 release builds, and main at e7e304d (reports 0.78.0); scratch stores under the hub session's scratchpad, isolated HOME.

① OBSERVED, the reporter's words (2026-10-02, 0.76.0): the fourth, successful add_decision call replied "revision": {"changed": false, "note": "This node already held exactly what this call passed; nothing moved."} while also reporting edges_drawn. "Inferred: one of the refused calls (2 or 3 …) had already written the node before its link validation failed … Not reproduced in isolation."

② PRECEDENT: fact:root-cause-a-typed-constructor-writes-the-node-before-its-later-checks-and-a-refusal-leaves-it-2026-10-02 (fixed by chg:a-refused-write-stores-nothing, #655) and fact:root-cause-nothing-moved-is-computed-from-properties-while-the-call-drew-an-edge-2026-09-28 (revision_of reads properties only).

④⑤ THE REPORTER'S SEQUENCE REPLAYED, on 0.76.0, 0.78.0 and main, over a store holding dec:base:
1. related_to [{node_id, relation: RELATES_TO}]: 0.76.0 exit 2, unknown field `node_id` only. 0.78.0 and main list all four problems at once (node_id, its nearest name other_id, relation not in the set, evidence missing).
2. related_to [{other_id, relation: RELATES_TO}]: 0.76.0 "called without the required argument `evidence`. Its own schema publishes no description of it".
3. with evidence, relation RELATES_TO: 0.76.0 exit 1, "'RELATES_TO' is not a relation a review can draw". get_node then FINDS dec:q with its name, decision and kind on 0.76.0, and finds nothing on 0.78.0 or main. Call 2 left nothing; call 3 is the leak.
4. relation DEPENDS_ON: 0.76.0 replies changed:false, "nothing moved", edges_drawn [dec:q DEPENDS_ON dec:base]. On 0.78.0 and main the node is created by this call.
The reporter's inference is CONFIRMED and narrowed to call 3.

WHAT IS STILL THERE: on main, add_decision on the existing dec:q with only a new related_to item replies edges_drawn [dec:q BLOCKS dec:base] and revision {changed: false, note: "This node already held exactly what this call passed; nothing moved."}. The 2026-09-28 cause, unchanged. 0.78.0's leak fix removed the route by which the field met it after refusals; any edge-only revise still meets it.

⑥ CLASS (as recorded 2026-09-28): the reply describes a call from one of its two outputs.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: which other constructors still say "nothing moved" on an edge-only revise on main. Only add_decision was re-measured.
